import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; contract=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")); d=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")); expected=contract["cases"][:2]; rows=[]
for c in expected:
 r=next(x for x in d["cases"] if x["id"]==sys.argv[3]+c["id"]); obs=next((x for x in r.get("observations",[]) if x["mode"]=="slg"),r); rows.append({"id":c["id"],"actualExit":obs["runExit"],"expectedExit":c["expectedRuntimeExit"],"passed":r["buildExit"]==0 and obs["runExit"]==c["expectedRuntimeExit"] and obs["stdout"]==c["expectedStdout"]})
print(json.dumps({"scope":"Retrospective normative oracle over preserved historical native observations; no compiler or native replay", "cases":rows}));sys.exit(0 if all(r["passed"] for r in rows) else 1)
